|game_text='''0 side — The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone'''

Deploy Watto's Junkyard, City Outskirts, and Credits Will Do Fine. {For} remainder of game, you may not deploy cards with ability except unique (•) aliens, Republic characters and starships, and [Episode I] Jedi. Your Destiny is suspended. While this side up, once per game may take Coruscant and/or Tatooine system into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. You may not deploy any systems. Maul is immune to attrition. {Flip} this card if there are 4 or more cards beneath Credits Will Do Fine.

'''7 side — We'll Need A New One'''

{While} this side up, your unique (•) Republic characters are power +1 and forfeit +2. Aliens may not have their deploy cost modified and Imperials deploy +1 to Tatooine sites. Whenever you complete a non-substituted battle destiny draw, may retrieve 1 Force (Force retrieved in this way may be taken into hand). While Queen's Royal Starship at a planet system, once during each of opponent's control phases may activate up to 2 Force. Once during each of your control phases, opponent loses 1 Force for each battleground site you occupy with a senator.

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Cor-L-wellneedanewone-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): The game text changes: “hand.)” becomes “hand).”; “opponent” is added after “your control phases,”. The slip no longer prints the title in its black strip; the “E” stays at the lower right.

The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip, both as cut from their sheets at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
